lines.say: Which one wrecks your day the most?
A, starting. B, switching between things. C, remembering what's next.
Comment your letter. Whichever it is, it's too many starts, not too little effort.
Offload holds the plan. Miss a day, and it moves the work, and tells you what moved.
So you never start from zero.
Offload. A study system that adapts when real life happens.
